title: Desk agent v0
description: One record for every agent the desk knows, wherever it comes from: Eris, the agents init.yaml names, agents that call the desk (the brain's agents, apps over MCP), agents of the brain's directory and the local agent programs a plugin runs (ADR 0100). What an agent does is a run, an item of kind run (specs/item/v0).

AgentId.description: An agent's id in the registry: eris, the agent id of an agent:<id> caller or of the brain's directory, or <plugin>/<id> for an agent a plugin runs (endue.local-agents/claude).

AgentSource.description: Where the desk knows the agent from. eris: the desk's own secretary. init: init.yaml's agents.<id>. caller: it called the desk as agent:<id> (a brain's tool call, an app over MCP). directory: the brain's agent directory (A2A tasks). local: a program a plugin runs on this computer.

AgentState.description: idle: nothing under way. working: a run is running. waiting: a run waits for the person's approval. error: its last run failed.

AgentRecord.description: One agent as the registry lists it now.

colour.description: The agent's colour, when it has one.

caller.description: The caller it calls the desk as, when it calls: agent:<id>.

brain.description: What thinks for it, in a word: endue, local, echo, or the program a plugin runs (claude, codex).

tools.description: The commands it may be granted: the cmd:invoke ids of its allowlist (init.yaml), or of its grants when it has no allowlist. Absent: none named.

runs.description: How many runs the desk has seen of it since it started.
